cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Change What the Apology Is For
cards.instruction: Get an apology, then reveal that the original offense was only the first layer of what needs repair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I accept your apology for breaking the vase.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The vase was cheap. You let me blame the dog for three days.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell the dog and me which part of that embarrassment we deserved.

mechanism: A corrects what replacement can repair, moving an accepted vase apology to responsibility for allowing false blame.
confusable: D197 enforces an unpleasant duty; D219 reveals a deeper layer after the first apology.
comparison: Cheap object/innocent blame differs from emotional absence/silence.
seedUse: Keep dog blamed and embarrassment, but direct an intelligible corrective act instead of asking dog to judge deserved embarrassment.
